title: pachifast.yaml
description: Configuration of a pachifast project. Environment variables and .env take precedence.

app.description: Identity and language of the application.

app_name.description: Name of the application, shown in the OpenAPI documentation.

project_name.description: Name of the project, reported by /api/health/ (empty: the application title, default PachiFast).

description.description: Description of the project, reported by /api/health/ (empty: no description).

version.description: Version of the project, reported by /api/health/ (empty: the application version, default 0.1.0).

default_locale.description: Language of the API error messages (language tag, e.g. en, it, pt-BR).

use_accept_language.description: Pick the message language from the Accept-Language header of each request.

api_v1_prefix.description: Prefix added to every API route.

server.description: Development server, API behaviour and response format.

host.description: Address the development server (`pachifast dev`) listens on.

debug.description: Show the traceback page to clients on errors: development only, off by default.

docs_enabled.description: Serve the Swagger UI (/docs, /docs/core) and the OpenAPI schemas; false removes them (404).

envelope_enabled.description: Wrap 2xx JSON in {success, message, data}; false: plain bodies (configure the client too).

request_id_enabled.description: Put an X-Request-ID header on every response and the id in every log line.

expose_response_database.description: Add the name of the database the data came from to the enveloped API responses.

wrap_auth_token_response.description: Wrap the login and refresh-token responses in the standard envelope.

dev.description: Switches for development only: never enable them in production.

global_noauth.description: Disable authentication on every router: development only.

swagger_noauth.description: Let the Swagger UI (/docs) act as the first superuser without a token: development only.

log_format.description: Format of the log lines: text (coloured) or json (one object per line).

log_level.description: Log level of the application; empty means DEBUG with `debug`, INFO otherwise.

routes.description: Routers and routes of the core and of the project that are not mounted.

disable_core_routers.description: Routers of the core not to mount (e.g. permissions).

disable_core_routes.description: Routes of the core not to expose: `[METHOD ]/path`, relative to /api.

disable_routers.description: Routers of the project not to mount.

disable_routes.description: Routes of the project not to expose: `[METHOD ]/path`, relative to /api.

database.description: Main database, connection pool and table prefix.

database_url.description: SQLAlchemy URL of the main database (async driver, e.g. postgresql+asyncpg://...). Prefer the environment variable or the .env file: do not commit it.

db_pool_size.description: Connections a server database (PostgreSQL) keeps open, per process.

db_max_overflow.description: Extra connections allowed above db_pool_size under load, per process.

db_pool_recycle.description: Seconds after which a connection is replaced; -1 never.

db_pool_timeout.description: Seconds a request waits for a free connection before it fails.

table_prefix.description: Prefix of every table name of the core.

auto_create_auth_schema.description: Create the auth tables at startup instead of using Alembic migrations.

cache.description: Cache of the application: in-process or shared Redis.

url.description: Empty: in-process cache. redis://, rediss:// or unix:// URL: shared Redis (needs pachifast[redis]).

prefix.description: Prefix of the cache keys, to share one Redis between applications.

max_entries.description: Maximum entries of the in-process cache.

auth.description: Authentication: database, tokens, passwords, login protection.

auth_database_url.description: SQLAlchemy URL of the authentication database (users, groups, permissions). Prefer the environment variable or the .env file: do not commit it.

secret_key.description: Secret that signs the tokens: random string of at least 32 characters, required. Prefer the environment variable or the .env file: do not commit it.

access_token_expire_minutes.description: Lifetime of an access token, in minutes.

refresh_token_expire_days.description: Lifetime of a refresh token, in days.

refresh_token_rotation.description: Every refresh issues a new, single-use refresh token; a reused one revokes the login.

refresh_reuse_grace_seconds.description: Grace seconds in which a reused refresh token is refused but the login is kept.

registration_enabled.description: Allow POST /auth/register (anyone can create an account); false answers 403.

login_max_attempts.description: Failed logins before the account is locked.

login_lockout_minutes.description: How long a locked account stays locked, in minutes.

auth_rate_limit.description: Requests per client address and window on login, registration and MFA check; 0 is no limit.

auth_rate_window_seconds.description: Length of the window of auth_rate_limit, in seconds.

encryption_key.description: Key of the TOTP secrets stored encrypted; empty: derived from secret_key. Prefer the environment variable or the .env file: do not commit it.

max_attempts.description: Wrong MFA codes allowed before the login challenge is discarded.

otp_expire_minutes.description: Minutes the user has to give the MFA code after the password.

send_cooldown_seconds.description: Seconds between two codes sent by the email or SMS enrolment; 0 is no wait.

tables.description: Names of the tables of the core (empty: table_prefix + default name).

user_table.description: Name of the users table (empty: table_prefix + user).

group_table.description: Name of the groups table (empty: table_prefix + group).

permission_table.description: Name of the permissions table (empty: table_prefix + permission).

user_group_table.description: Name of the user-group table (empty: table_prefix + user_group).

user_permission_table.description: Name of the user-permission table (empty: table_prefix + user_permission).

group_permission_table.description: Name of the group-permission table (empty: table_prefix + group_permission).

user_settings_table.description: Name of the user settings table (empty: table_prefix + user_settings).

mfa_config_table.description: Name of the MFA configuration table (empty: table_prefix + mfa_config).

mfa_pending_table.description: Name of the pending MFA challenges table (empty: table_prefix + mfa_pending).

activity_log.description: Activity log of the write requests.

enabled.description: Record POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests in the activity log and expose it.

exclude_paths.description: Comma-separated path fragments that are never logged.

retention_days.description: Days of activity log that `pachifast audit purge` keeps; 0 needs --days.

table.description: Name of the activity log table (empty: table_prefix + activity_log).

allow_query_token.description: Accept the access token in the WebSocket URL (?token=); false: one-time tickets only.

public_types.description: Event types sent to every client (e.g. login); default: superusers and the user concerned.

ticket_store.description: Where the WebSocket tickets live: the auth database (shared by workers) or the cache.
